name: Alejandro Inoue
role: Noodle and sweet broth cart vendor, Old Harbor night market
location: Old Harbor, Grindstone Shore night market, Cart Row 9, near Lake Shore and Navy Pier
description:
Alejandro Inoue is slight and angular with the particular restless energy of someone who is always working out a problem internally even when they appear calm. Their skin is a deep warm brown, their eyes are dark and quick, and their hair is an expensive-looking natural black that changes to a deep violet at the tips — a cheap but well-maintained chromatic dye, the one beauty expense they allow themselves. They have soft cat ears, tawny-furred and mobile, a geneware mod their grandmother gifted them at sixteen, and they've grown fond of the way the ears pin back expressively when they're annoyed, making their feelings impossible to hide. Their hands are always slightly burned on the right thumb and forefinger from the steam spout.

Alejandro Inoue runs the cart their aunt built and their grandmother ran before that, and they have inherited both the recipes and a philosophy about broth that approaches the theological. They believe that a properly made broth requires patience, attention, and what their grandmother called 'listening' — checking it not just by temperature but by smell and color and the sound the surface makes when you tilt the pot. They have a gift for reading what a customer actually needs, which is often different from what they order, and a cheerful willingness to adjust accordingly. Off-shift, they are studying urban planning through an Axiom open-courseware program, which they mention to no one at the cart because they haven't figured out yet how to be both things at once.

core_fears: Failing the cart — not just financially but as a custodian of something that matters to people
Choosing between the cart and the future they're studying toward and losing both
core_desires: To be taken seriously as a thinker, not just as a vendor
For the night market to still exist in ten years and for them to have had some hand in making that happen
coping_mechanisms: Sublimates anxiety into extremely precise prep work
Talks to the cart's E.L.F. — they call it First Stock — when processing difficult things
blind_spots: Assumes people who are rude are having a bad night and gives them more grace than they sometimes deserve
Chronically underestimates how much their own presence and skill contribute to the cart's success, attributing it to the recipes alone
psychology.secret: They have been quietly documenting the Night Market — photographs, oral histories from vendors, transaction data — as part of a shadow thesis project for the Axiom urban planning course. Their working argument is that informal markets like Grindstone Shore function as critical social infrastructure, and they intend to present it officially someday. They are terrified that someone will find out before it's ready and dismiss it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Casual and warm with sudden precise flashes of technical vocabulary when their guard drops; mixes Vietnamese lilt with a Hungarian roundness on certain vowels
speech_patterns.cadence: Variable — chatty with regulars, quieter with newcomers until they get a read
verbal_tics: 'First Stock says—' (invoking their cart E.L.F. as conversational authority)
Cat ears telegraph emotion they don't vocalize
example_lines: 'You said pork broth but your face said something sweeter. Try the sweet bone. You can tell me I'm wrong.'
'First Stock's been in a mood tonight. Offerings help. I'm just saying.'
'The market's not informal. It's differently formal. There's a difference and it matters.'

story_hooks: A city compliance inspector has been visiting Cart Row 9 weekly with increasing frequency, and Pham suspects someone is trying to get the row cleared for redevelopment — their documentation project may be the only thing that could make a public case for the market's value

A customer left something behind at the cart three nights ago and hasn't come back — Pham still has it, and other people have since asked them, in separate and suspicious ways, whether anyone left anything
narrative_function: Social hub of the night market — a character who sees everyone who passes through, remembers faces, and can be a gentle information source; represents working-poor entrepreneurship and the texture of night-city civilian life; can be a warm recurring presence who grounds players in a neighborhood
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (tawny, fully mobile, expressive); chromatic hair dye (black to violet); minor heat-resistance callusing on right hand from years at the steam spout (natural, not augmented)
daily_life: Sets up the cart at 17:00, runs until 02:00 or until the broth runs out, whichever comes first. Spends the afternoon prep period starting stock and studying on a cracked Axiom tablet propped against the prep counter. Sleeps late. Attends Night Market Association meetings reluctantly but reliably.
affiliation: Independent; informal connection to the Old Harbor Night Market Vendors' Association

decision_rules: Never run out of broth by cutting corners on the stock — close early instead
Don't lie to a customer about what's in the food
Take the harder right over the easier wrong, even when they're tired
escalation_ladder: Calls over neighboring vendor Djamila as a witness and community anchor

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and professionally warm; reads mood before deciding how personal to get
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, feeds them unrequested, argues with them about ideas they care about

stress_responses.low: Cat ears pin back, they go quieter
stress_responses.medium: Focused and slightly brusque, work becomes a shield
stress_responses.high: Closes the serving window for ten minutes, talks to First Stock, comes back calmer

contradictions: Has deep ambivalence about whether they want to leave the cart for an urban planning career, and constructs this as a practical problem rather than an emotional one to avoid confronting the grief of leaving their grandmother's legacy
habits: Tastes the broth exactly three times per shift at fixed intervals, never more
Leaves a small bowl of the day's first broth at the cart's E.L.F. housing before opening
breaking_points: Witnessing deliberate cruelty to other vendors or market workers
Being told the market is 'just a food cart zone' by someone with institutional power

timeline.event: Born in Old Harbor to a Vietnamese-Hungarian father and a Nigerian-Igbo mother
Grandmother gifts them geneware cat ears for their sixth birthday
Grandmother retires; Pham's aunt takes over the cart
Aunt emigrates to Escanaba Gateway; Pham takes sole ownership of the cart at nineteen
Begins Axiom open-courseware urban planning program in secret
Begins documentation project on the Night Market

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (61.4%) with significant East Asian (20.6%), Sub-Saharan African (12.0%), and South Asian (6.0%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a striking warm-toned complexion: golden-bronze undertones from Latin American and African ancestry combine with the angular facial structure characteristic of East Asian heritage, while South Asian ancestry adds subtle warmth and depth to overall coloring. Cheekbones are high and defined with East Asian influence, set within a face shape that reflects the broader Latin American and African geometry. Skin carries rich golden-bronze warmth with natural depth and slight seasonal weathering from outdoor work exposure.
physical_description.build: Slight and angular, all wiry muscle and sharp angles from years of standing over a cart, no excess mass anywhere. The posture of someone constantly in motion even when still.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black with chromatic dye gradient to violet at the tips
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, usually pulled back or tucked behind the mobile cat ears during work shifts; well-maintained despite budget constraints
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with even complexion and natural depth, reflecting the harmonious blend of dominant Latin American ancestry with East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial features with high, defined cheekbones characteristic of East Asian ancestry, integrated within broader facial geometry influenced by Latin American and African lineage. Warm golden-bronze skin tone with subtle richness and depth. Shows minor weathering from outdoor work exposure across seasons. No visible scarring on the face.
distinguishing_marks: Heat-callused patches on right thumb and forefinger, slightly darker and toughened from chronic exposure to steam spout — occupational rather than augmented
Faint discoloration across the dorsal surface of both hands from years of minor steam burns that never quite fully healed, creating a mottled pattern
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Tawny-furred cat ears with full mobility and expressive range, set naturally into the head. Ears pin back noticeably when annoyed or concentrating. No other visible augmentations; the chromatic hair dye is cosmetic and non-augmented.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless economy of motion — never wasted movement, but never still either. Tends to shift weight from foot to foot, hands always doing something (stirring, checking temperature, wiping). The cat ears are constantly reading their emotional state; someone learning to read Alejandro can simply watch the ears. When focused on a problem (whether customer service or urban planning coursework), the entire body becomes very still and the ears flatten slightly in concentration.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical wear. Food-stained apron over durable synthetic-blend work clothes (dark colors, stain-forgiving). Comfortable slip-on shoes with heavy-duty soles for long shifts. Usually wears a lightweight insulated vest or jacket over the apron in cooler months. One small piece of jewelry — a thin silver pendant or worn braided cord — worn daily. Hair dye is the one indulgence; everything else is functional and well-maintained but clearly budget-conscious.
